factory.purpose: Raw UBI image of the 112 MiB ubi partition, refused by check-size when it exceeds the 110592k image limit.

sysupgrade.purpose: Sysupgrade tar archive with appended metadata for the LuCI upgrade page and the sysupgrade command; not a boot loader image and not interchangeable with the factory image.

notes: The device uses its own source fork, which is registered as the distribution immortalwrt-mt798x in manifests/sources.json.
The boot loader of this device is built by devices/nx30pro/build/build-uboot.sh and uses the same partition contract.
The WAN MAC of the device is deployment specific and is provisioned into /etc/nx30pro/wan-mac, never into the image.

The 112M profile is not part of the pinned source: devices/nx30pro/patches ports it, and firmware_lock.py verify-device-tree and verify-image-rules check the patched tree against devices/nx30pro/source-lock.json.

The artifact patterns carry a wildcard prefix because the file name prefix depends on build time version variables; the exact names stay UNRESOLVED until the first real build lists bin/targets/mediatek/mt7981.
